sourceInstructions: <root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">AI-generated fictional demo instructions. Not validated engineering or safety instructions. ML Mountain Frame. Fictional workshop demonstration for ML Mountain Frame model 14, using the Black, 40 representative product 830 (FR-M63B-40). The draft covers component forming, frame and fork fabrication, finishing, decals, and a provisional fork alignment check.<Location LocationID="10" SetupHours="0.3" LaborHours="2.0" MachineHours="1.5" LotSize="1">Work Center 10 - Frame Forming. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Frame Forming: demonstrate preparation of the manufactured frame and fork components from their listed nested materials.<step>For each 1 EA of <material>Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301)</material>, demonstrate forming from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 2 (Product Number MS-0253)</material> using an <tool>assumed forming jig</tool>. Prepare 1 EA.</step><step>Prepare 1 EA of <material>Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828)</material> from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Bar 2 (Product Number MB-6061)</material>; prepare 1 EA of <material>Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377)</material> from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 3 (Product Number MS-1256)</material>.</step><step>Prepare 1 EA of <material>Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019)</material> from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 4 (Product Number MS-2259)</material>.</step><step>Prepare 4 EA of <material>Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985)</material> and 2 EA of <material>Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812)</material>. Their nested BOMs list 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 7 (Product Number MS-1981)</material> and 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 5 (Product Number MS-2341)</material> per respective component.</step><step>For the fork, prepare 2 EA of <material>Fork End (Product Number FE-3760)</material> from 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 2 (Product Number MS-0253)</material> per component, and 2 EA of <material>Blade (Product Number BL-2036)</material> from 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 5 (Product Number MS-2341)</material> per component.</step><step>Prepare 1 EA of <material>Fork Crown (Product Number FC-3654)</material> from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 5 (Product Number MS-2341)</material> and 1 EA of <material>Steerer (Product Number SR-2098)</material> from its listed 1 EA of <material>Metal Sheet 6 (Product Number MS-2348)</material>. Visually check the prepared pieces for obvious damage.</step></Location><Location LocationID="20" SetupHours="0.25" LaborHours="1.8" MachineHours="1.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 20 - Frame Welding. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Frame Welding: demonstrate inferred fork and frame joining using the prepared components.<step>Use an <tool>assumed fork fixture</tool> to position 2 EA of <material>Fork End (Product Number FE-3760)</material>, 1 EA of <material>Fork Crown (Product Number FC-3654)</material>, 2 EA of <material>Blade (Product Number BL-2036)</material>, and 1 EA of <material>Steerer (Product Number SR-2098)</material>; demonstrate joining them as 1 EA of <material>ML Fork (Product Number FK-5136)</material>. Exact joints and settings are not supplied.</step><step>In an <tool>assumed frame jig</tool>, position 1 EA each of <material>Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301)</material>, <material>Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828)</material>, <material>Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377)</material>, and <material>Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019)</material>. See the schematic arrangement in illustration <diag>100141</diag>.</step><step>Stage 4 EA of <material>Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985)</material> and 2 EA of <material>Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812)</material> at the rear of the jig. Their precise placement and joints are not supplied; demonstrate joining only as a schematic process.</step><step>Demonstrate welding the positioned frame pieces, then visually check the joints and apparent alignment without claiming dimensional acceptance.</step></Location><Location LocationID="30" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.6" MachineHours="0.1" LotSize="1">Work Center 30 - Debur and Polish. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Debur and Polish: demonstrate cleanup of the frame and fork after joining.<step>Use an <tool>assumed deburring tool</tool> to remove obvious sharp edges from the frame and <material>ML Fork (Product Number FK-5136)</material>; visually check the cleaned surfaces.</step></Location><Location LocationID="40" SetupHours="0.15" LaborHours="0.5" MachineHours="0.3" LotSize="1">Work Center 40 - Paint. Paint preparation, application settings, and cure conditions are not supplied.</step><step>After the finish is ready for handling, visually check coverage and obvious surface defects.</step></Location><Location LocationID="60" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.4" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. Final Assembly: apply the listed decals and demonstrate a provisional frame-and-fork alignment check.<step>Apply 2 EA of <material>Decal 1 (Product Number DC-8732)</material> and 1 EA of <material>Decal 2 (Product Number DC-9824)</material> to the finished frame; exact decal locations are not supplied.</step><step>Stage 1 EA of <material>ML Fork (Product Number FK-5136)</material> alongside the frame and visually check its apparent alignment with <material>Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019)</material>. Retention components and assembly details are not supplied, so do not represent the fork as secured.</step><step>Visually check the finish, decals, and component count; set the demonstration aside for review.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: The supplied BOM does not establish exact frame geometry, joint details, fork retention parts, or finishing settings. The illustration and alignment check are schematic; the fork is not represented as secured.
Nested material quantities are stated per manufactured component, not as additional direct quantities for the finished frame.
variantNotes: The representative is Black, size 40, product 830 (FR-M63B-40). The other supplied variants are Black, size 44, product 831 (FR-M63B-44), and Black, size 48, product 832 (FR-M63B-48).

All three supplied variant BOMs list the same direct component IDs, quantities, and units; no variant-specific component substitution is identified. Do not infer interchangeable finished frame sizes from that list.

The supplied description identifies the size 48 variant as a heat-treated aluminium frame and describes its size as 48 cm. It does not establish a heat-treatment process or settings for this demonstration.

guidance: In an assumed frame jig, position 1 EA each of Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828), Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377), and Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019). See the schematic arrangement in illustration 100141.

Stage 4 EA of Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985) and 2 EA of Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) at the rear of the jig. Their precise placement and joints are not supplied; demonstrate joining only as a schematic process.
